_doc: Prose voice contract for NFRI essays — not rendered directly; informs manifesto.json, argument.json, analysis.json edits. Blend: Felix Stocker (index-as-product), Katherine Boyle / a16z American Dynamism (physical-world seriousness), ARC Reindustrialise (capacity, energy, builders).
principles: Lead with a physical-world claim, not a product feature — the grid, the queue, the connection agreement.
Name the builder class: underwriters, carriers, asset operators who must carry what the market is piling on.
Treat the dataset as the artifact; the chart is the argument (Stocker).
Separate root cause from symptom — reindustrialisation fails without affordable, firm-enough power (ARC).
Bold thesis, measured evidence — every number is cited or flagged PROVISIONAL.
Short punchy kickers in ALL CAPS for section labels; body in long-form essay sentences.
Avoid vendor marketing, ESG boilerplate, and synthetic confidence.

patterns.kicker: Two to four words, uppercase, no full stop — e.g. THE PERIL, THE STACK, THE GAP.
patterns.opening: One sentence that reframes the dominant question the market asks (damage → interruption; hazard → preparedness).
patterns.manifesto_line: We [verb] the [physical noun] — parallel to Ocean's 'we steward the oceans'.
patterns.five_steps: Numbered industrial agenda when arguing policy — reform, invest, energy, skills, supply chains.
